_comment: HELD BY FAITH (@HeldByFaithJourney, UCh0tKIGR5Ns3Wvoai__txdg) packaging config. Rewritten 2026-09-12 against live channel state; the 2026-08-04 version described a channel that no longer exists. Machine-readable — automation/heldbyfaith_packaging.py applies it. Read heldbyfaith/channel-diagnosis.md first.
_what_changed: The August config existed to fix a 33-view channel that had been dark for three weeks: five retitles collapsing four series names into one, and an unlist gated on a Chapter 6 that was never made. All of it is now either done or moot. The channel is at 24,364 views on 28 vertical Shorts published in eight days, the six legacy uploads were renumbered Part 1-6 in correct story order by hand, and the fix this file now carries is a different one — the channel converts 24K views into 61 subscribers because both of its front doors point at its worst video.
_expect_channel_id: Enforced before any write: the script resolves the authenticated channel with mine=true and aborts unless it equals this. Stops an HBF_* secret minted against the wrong channel from writing this channel's metadata onto Finance % Decoded, and stops new1/new2/new3 from ever driving this file.
_credentials: STILL MISSING as of 2026-09-12. HBF_CLIENT_ID, HBF_CLIENT_SECRET and HBF_REFRESH_TOKEN are all unset — verified by 'HELD BY FAITH - 1. Check setup' run 34673924580, which failed with all three reported MISSING. Nothing in this file can be applied by automation until they exist; heldbyfaith/channel-diagnosis.md carries the Studio copy-paste equivalents. Mint the token with automation/authorize.html and pick HELD BY FAITH at Google's chooser. Do NOT reuse new1/new2/new3.
_landscape_video_ids: The three 16:9 uploads. 5 views between them at 60-72 days old, against 905 each for the vertical Shorts. The monitor reads this list from automation/channels.json to keep the format split in every report.
_retitle: Deliberately empty, and that is the fix. The August config held five entries collapsing 'Pancreatic Cancer Journey Ep. 1' / 'Muslim Cancer Story Ch. 3' / one unnumbered title into a single Chapter scheme. Someone did that work by hand and did it better: the six legacy uploads are now Part 1-6 and the order is the true story order — Kaaba dua, the 7-day wait, the phone call, feeling nothing, telling the family, the surgery. Every current_title recorded in the old config is therefore stale, and heldbyfaith_packaging.py would have skipped all five with 'live title drifted' and failed the run. Leaving the entries in would have looked like pending work. There is none.
_unlist: Also deliberately empty. The August config had 14mGEhEieZY queued for unlisting once Ch. 6 shipped; Ch. 6 never shipped and the channel went somewhere else entirely. Unlisting is still the wrong move for a different reason now: the three landscape videos are Part 1, Part 3 and Part 6 of a six-part spine, so removing them opens holes in the middle of the only ordered account of the diagnosis on the channel. The cost they carry is not that they are listed, it is that they are what the channel description and the playlist point new viewers AT. That is what the channel block below fixes. Re-cutting them vertical is the real repair; do not delete anything on this channel.

channel._why: Two channel-level fields, and between them they are the highest-leverage change available. 24,364 lifetime views have produced 61 subscribers — one per 399 views. Reach is solved; the destination is not.
channel._keywords: The live field is BROKEN and this repairs it. YouTube's channel keyword field is space-separated, and a phrase only stays a phrase inside double quotes. The live value was pasted unquoted, so the API returns 30 single words: 'muslim', 'cancer', 'story', 'pancreatic'... 'held', 'by', 'faith'. The channel's own name is not registering as a term, and 'by', 'when' and 'through' are indexed as keywords. heldbyfaith_packaging.py quotes any term containing a space before writing, so applying this list fixes it; pasting this list into Studio by hand does not, unless the quotes go in too. The list keeps every phrase the owner chose and adds 'life after cancer' and 'cancer survivor story', which is what 28 of the 31 Shorts are actually about.
channel.description:
I stood in front of the Kaaba and asked Allah for more time. Four days later I was diagnosed with pancreatic cancer.

This is the record of what came after. The 10 hour Whipple surgery, the recovery, the doubt, the scar, and the faith that carried me through it. I am not filming this to relive the pain. I am filming it so that the next person who gets that phone call does not have to sit in it alone.

If you are the one who was just diagnosed, or you are the one holding their hand, start here:
https://youtu.be/X4z5Ij0SQgI
The whole journey in order: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLczfvNC3NVjo

A new piece of the story every single day. Subscribe and walk it with me.

For business or to share your own story: heldbyfaithjourney@gmail.com
channel._description: ONE line changes. Every sentence of the owner's own account is preserved character for character — this is his cancer diary and the prose is not ours to edit. What moves is the link under 'start here', from https://youtu.be/GFKRpV_mhWg to https://youtu.be/X4z5Ij0SQgI. GFKRpV_mhWg is Part 1: a 1:58 LANDSCAPE video with 4 lifetime views, the single worst-performing upload on the channel. It is the first link a viewer sees after being moved by a Short, and it is also the video the playlist opens on. X4z5Ij0SQgI is 'I survived. He didn't. Nobody prepares you for that' — 1,235 views and 35 likes, a 2.8% like rate and the highest engagement on the channel. Sending a new viewer to the video most likely to move them, instead of to the one least likely to, is the whole of this change.

channel._current_description: Drift guard, same contract as current_title on a retitle. Read live 2026-09-12. If the live description is neither this nor the target above, someone edited it in Studio and the script refuses to write rather than silently clobber it — which on a channel-level description containing the owner's own words is the difference between a fix and a loss.

protected._why: Never repackage a proven winner. Refreshed 2026-09-12: the old list protected 1TGtRIpgwt4, which held 12 of the channel's 33 lifetime views in August and now holds 13 of 24,364. It is no longer a winner and protecting it protects nothing. These five are the settled top performers of the wave that actually built the channel, and their hooks, descriptions and tags are the reference for everything written next.

do_not_touch._why: Per-video tags and descriptions across this channel are genuinely good — 14 to 17 specific tags each, chaptered, series-linked, with a proper medical disclaimer. They are not the problem and rewriting them would burn effort while risking a real asset. Note the scope: description_body means the description of a VIDEO. The channel-level description in the channel block above is a different field and is in scope, for the single link named there.
